question: Which edition of the Offshore Security Coordination Committee (OSCC) was held in New Delhi in June 2025 (led by the Indian Coast guard) with a key focus to evaluate offshore infrastructure security and develop better multi-agency?
solution:
The correct answer is __**137th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **137th edition** of the **Offshore Security Coordination Committee (OSCC)** was convened in **New Delhi** in **June 2025** to deliberate on the evolving security landscape of India's maritime assets.
 
• The meeting was presided over by the **Director General** of the **Indian Coast Guard (ICG)**, who serves as the **Chairman** of the committee, ensuring a unified approach toward safeguarding offshore wealth.
 
• A primary objective of this session was to evaluate the **security of offshore infrastructure**, particularly the oil and gas installations located in the **Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ)** of India. ***Hence, the statement regarding the focus on infrastructure is correct.***
 
• The committee emphasized the development of better **multi-agency coordination**, involving stakeholders such as the **Indian Navy**, **Indian Coast Guard**, **ONGC**, and various **state police** departments to streamline response mechanisms during emergencies.
